Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Lords' Alliance
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 1
Order: Recruit

A luxurious apartment fit for the ruler of a city such as Neverwinter, Waterdeep, or Baldur's Gate. Your hireling is a butler who tends to the resident's needs. After you spend a Long Rest in your Noble Residence, you gain Heroic Inspiration.

Recruit: Visiting Noble. You give up sleeping here for 14 days and offer the residence to a noble of a Lords' Alliance settlement you choose. Roll any die: on an odd number, nothing comes of it; on an even number, a noble arrives within 7 days and stays for another 7. They gossip about their home, revealing the location of any creature familiar to you within 50 miles of their settlement, unless it is hidden by magic or somewhere the DM deems beyond their knowledge; if they know it, they also tell you where it was during the 7 days before they left. The noble won't defend your Bastion and leaves at once if it is attacked.

Source: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn.
